holes_found.description: ISS-2536 substantive fix landed (TLDR + body now use accurate 'denominator-nullified' / 'denominator the dome's own data sets to zero' framing), but the section heading still reads '2.13 The κ Coupling Constant: Divide-by-Zero with the Dome's Own Later Data'. A dome defender will note that the headline phrase 'Divide-by-Zero' describes the dome's current internal state (the subsequent null confirmations contradict the original denominator), not the literal arithmetic of kappa's derivation pair, which was -10.9 nT / -6.5 µGal — non-zero on both sides. The qualifier 'with the Dome's Own Later Data' is doing significant rhetorical work to make the headline accurate. This is now a stylistic-rhetoric concern rather than a substantive imprecision (the body and TLDR explicitly walk it back), and the headline does drive engagement, so reasonable reviewers can split on whether to keep it.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional alternatives to consider, in decreasing order of preserved rhetorical punch: (a) keep current heading — the qualifier makes it defensible; (b) 'The κ Coupling Constant: Denominator Nullified by the Dome's Own Later Data' — accurate and almost as catchy; (c) 'The κ Coupling Constant: The Dome's Own Later Confirmations Null Its Denominator' — most precise, less catchy. Recommendation: ship option (a) (no change) unless an external reviewer or the dome author specifically calls out the headline as a strawman; in that case ship (b).
